segments.name: Semiconductor Systems
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and sells equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging.
segments.evidence: Our Semiconductor Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and sells a wide range of equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips, also referred to as integrated circuits (ICs).

segments.name: Applied Global Services
segments.description: Provides services, spares and factory automation software to optimize performance of semiconductor equipment globally.
segments.evidence: Our AGS segment provides services, spares and factory automation software to customer fabrication plants globally.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor manufacturers purchase capital equipment and services to fabricate chips and optimize installed equipment performance.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business is based on capital equipment investments by major semiconductor and other manufacturers, and is subject to significant variability in customer demand for our products.
